sentences.l2: 当代年轻人陷入了一种耐人寻味的矛盾：白天的时间被工作与娱乐填满，唯有深夜真正属于自己，于是熬夜成了难以割舍的习惯；然而清晨照镜子时浮现的疲惫与倦怠，又让他们对养生表现出近乎虔诚的热情。
sentences.l1: Today's young people have fallen into an intriguing contradiction: their daytime hours are filled with work and entertainment, and only the late night truly belongs to them, so staying up late has become a habit they cannot give up; yet the fatigue and weariness that appear when they look in the mirror in the morning give them an almost devout enthusiasm for health preservation.

sentences.l2: 保温杯里泡着枸杞，办公桌上摆着各类保健品，这些近乎仪式化的举动仿佛足以抵消前一夜的透支。
sentences.l1: Goji berries steep in thermos cups and all kinds of health supplements sit on office desks; these almost ritualized acts seem enough to offset the overdraft of the night before.

sentences.l2: 可这种一边挥霍健康、一边竭力补救的生活方式，恰恰折射出普遍存在的亚健康焦虑——身体尚未出现明确的病症，却持续发出疲惫、失眠与注意力涣散的信号。
sentences.l1: But this way of life, squandering health on one hand and desperately trying to make up for it on the other, precisely reflects the widespread anxiety of sub-health: the body has not yet shown a clear illness, but keeps sending signals of fatigue, insomnia and scattered attention.

sentences.l2: 真正的养生或许并不取决于枸杞的多少，而在于是否愿意承认：健康从不是一笔可以事后赎回的债务。
sentences.l1: True health preservation perhaps does not depend on how many goji berries you have, but on whether you are willing to admit that health is never a debt that can be redeemed afterwards.
